result.name: name_words
result.description: The words asset file names are actually made of in a scope (repo / branch, optionally one type), most used first. Call it before searching for anything described by meaning, in another language or by look, then search with words from this list.

repo.description: A repo the user named; part of its name is enough

result.name: search_assets
result.description: Search Unity assets and show the results in the hub (it fills the search box and picks the type tab). Searches the open branch, every branch of the open repo, or every indexed repo. Understands synonyms and typos; use short English keywords as in file names (e.g. "fire", "explosion smoke"). Returns the best matches with refs.

query.description: Keywords; " | " between alternatives matches any of them, e.g. "fire | flame | burn"

type.description: Only this asset type (tab), e.g. vfx for effects

where.description: branch: the open branch (default); repo: every branch of the open repo; all: every repo

repo.description: A repo the user named; part of its name is enough ("pizza"). Opens that repo in the hub and searches every branch of it (where is then ignored).

result.name: open_asset
result.description: Open an asset in the hub: its repo and branch, with the preview and details shown.

ref.description: An asset reference exactly as returned by search_assets ("owner/repo@branch:path").

result.name: asset_info
result.description: Details of an asset: size, measured stats (triangles, textures…), whether it fits the playable budget, and what it depends on.

ref.description: An asset reference exactly as returned by search_assets ("owner/repo@branch:path").

result.name: add_to_chest
result.description: Add assets of the open branch to the chest (the export list). The user exports it themselves.

items.description: An asset reference exactly as returned by search_assets ("owner/repo@branch:path").

result.name: add_to_collection
result.description: Add assets to a collection by name (made when it does not exist). "Favourites" is the starred list.

items.description: An asset reference exactly as returned by search_assets ("owner/repo@branch:path").

result.name: offer_choices
result.description: Show reply buttons under your message, so the user answers with one click. Use it instead of asking in words when a request is unclear and the answer changes what you do. Then end your turn with a one-line question. A clicked button sends its label as the user's reply.

options.description: Short labels in the user's language

other.description: Add an "Other…" button that lets the user type their own answer
